summary: Frontend-only regression testing of Il Pescematto static Expo web SPA after re-adding iOS/Android bundleIdentifier/package to app.json. All 10 requested flows pass. App loads without red screen or console errors, all documented testIDs resolve, Home/Menu/Info tabs render correctly, cookie notice dismiss + reopen via 'Gestisci cookie' link works, Cookie Policy and Privacy Policy pages load, admin login with PESCEMATTO/MRPescematto.2026 succeeds and navigates to /admin/settings, and menu editor opens the piatto editing modal with name/price/save. Only a benign React Native Web deprecation warning was observed ('props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents').

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely coming from a View/Pressable prop; replace with style={{ pointerEvents: '...' }}. Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: replace remaining `pointerEvents` props with `style.pointerEvents` to silence the RN Web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: app.json now includes ios.bundleIdentifier='com.emergent.ilpescematto.jurrg4' and android.package='com.emergent.ilpescematto.jurrg4' — consistent, no regressions observed on the web build.
seed_data_creation: None. Static app using localStorage; no seed required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested flows verified with mobile viewport 375x667. TestIDs list from the request all resolved. Admin credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md work. No backend involved.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Re-adding bundleIdentifier/package to app.json does not affect the web bundle behavior.
